newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF to boost drugs growth under own power.
newsitem.headline: BASF to boost drugs growth under own power.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group BASF AG said on Thursday that it planned to increase sales in its drugs division through internal growth not through further acquisitions.
"To achieve this we are betting on new products," BASF management board member Gerhard Wolf told shareholders. The group had promising products to treat obesity, pain, and schizophrenia.
BASF said it was expecting the largest gain from the obesity drug Meridia.
Wolf also said: "We don't rule out acquisitions but they must fit with us strategically."
Analysts have said that BASF would be in a position to make more purchases and should do so in order to keep pace with the fast-paced consolidation in the pharmaceuticals industry.
BASF said the income from operations in the health and nutrition sector stood at 325 million marks in the first quarter, down 12 million marks from year ago levels.
